title: VignetteBackdropManifest
description: Per-vignette atmospheric backdrop: layered parallax assets + continuous ambient motion + scene-to-scene transitions. The backdrop is the world *living* behind the choice UI — it never freezes while the player deliberates. See docs/05_Technical_Architecture.md §'Atmospheric backdrops in the renderer' and docs/07 T-CLIENT-041.

vignette_id.description: The vignette this backdrop renders behind. Must match an id in the Season.

mood.description: Renderer hints for color grading and ambient sound mix. Not part of layer composition.

mode.description: How the camera reacts to input. 'parallax' shifts on pointer/accelerometer; 'orbital' slow-orbits a focal point; 'static' is a fixed shot with only in-layer ambient motion.

sensitivity.description: Parallax response strength. 0 = no input reaction; 1 = full reaction. Always damped; never reaches a startle level.

transition.description: How this backdrop fades in/out when entering/leaving the vignette.

layers.description: Painter's-order layers, back to front. Each is keyed by parallax_depth so the renderer can sort and weight responses.

id.description: Layer id, unique within the backdrop.

asset_id.description: References AssetSpec.id in the Season's asset manifest. The validator does NOT yet cross-check this (asset manifests and backdrops are authored in lockstep).

parallax_depth.description: 0 = at the camera (largest motion); 100 = at infinity (no motion). Layers are sorted by depth, descending, for painter's-order draw.

ambient.description: Continuous motion applied to this layer. The composition of these is what keeps the world feeling alive while the player thinks.

oneOf.description: Slow sinusoidal pan. Used for sky, clouds, wind on grass.
Slow opacity oscillation. Used for distant light sources, embers.

density.description: 0 = none, 1 = thick. The renderer maps this to a particle count appropriate for the device.

oneOf.description: Abstract particle emitter. Density is normalized; the renderer maps it to a count appropriate for the device.

amplitude.description: Fractional depth pulse. Tiny by design — perceptible only as life, never as motion sickness.

oneOf.description: Subtle depth pulsation, an inhale/exhale of the scene. Always low-amplitude.
